blocks.text: Command White Large Utility Hooks let you decorate and organize how you want, when you want, without damaging your walls and surfaces. A great home improvement item, these no damage wall hooks stick on a variety of smooth surfaces without leaving holes, marks or sticky residue. Use these hanging hooks to hang clipboards, brushes, dog leashes, kitchen utensils, home decor and accessories. Simply mount these wall adhesive hooks on painted walls, finished wood, painted concrete cinder blocks, laminate, glass, metal and tiles and enjoy the damage free hanging of your favorite decorations and organizers. Perfect for home renovators and college students, use these wall hooks for hanging decorations and organizers in your home, office, apartment or dorm room to elevate the appearance of your living or working space without tools. Directions are included; follow the directions closely to use the wall hangers as intended. A clever decorating and organizing solution that doesn’t damage surfaces, these large tool free wall hangers will help you fearlessly change your space. One package contains seven white utility hooks and 12 large adhesive strips. Each single utility adhesive wall hook can hold up to 5 pounds. Decorate, organize and celebrate damage free with Command.

items.label: HOLDS UP TO 5 POUNDS
items.value: One package of the Command Large Utility Hooks includes seven wall hooks and 12 adhesive strips; each utility wall hanger can hold up to 5 pounds

items.label: DAMAGE FREE HANGING
items.value: Wall hooks work without leaving holes, marks or sticky residue so you can move and rehang clipboards, brushes, dog leashes, kitchen utensils, home decor and accessories or use as a coat hook to hang your favorite jackets and coats

items.label: WORKS ON A VARIETY OF SMOOTH SURFACES
items.value: Adhesive wall hangers work on a variety of smooth surfaces, including painted walls, finished wood, painted concrete cinder blocks, laminate, glass, metal and tiles

items.label: SURFACE PREP
items.value: Clean with rubbing alcohol to remove grime and dust to allow the hanging hooks to bond to the surface; the indoor temperature must be between 50 degrees Fahrenheit and 105 degrees Fahrenheit

items.label: USAGE TIPS
items.value: Wait seven days after painting before using the Command Hooks to allow paint to cure; do not hang over beds or on wallpaper; do not use the wall hooks for hanging valuable items

items.label: EASY CLEAN REMOVAL
items.value: Lightly hold the top of the wall adhesive strips and slowly pull straight down towards the floor to remove the 3M Hooks and prevent damage of walls and surfaces; reuse your hook and hardware again by purchasing refill strips

items.label: Surface Recommendation
items.value: Painted Walls, Finished Wood, Painted Concrete Cinder Blocks, Laminate, Glass, Metal, Tiles
